admission_preconditions: q1 parent qualification receipt is verified=true and qualified=true.
Measured q1 process-tree peak is no greater than 9,216,000,000 bytes.
Persistence attribution has proved the exact branch-dependent state closure needed from byte 32 through byte 63.
The complete fork allocation manifest is frozen before any SAFE-FORK archive executes.
K, D, M, R, and S use the same allocation classes and capacities; P records the parent-only reference footprint.
A cgroup-v2 memory.max of 10,000,000,000 bytes and process-tree RSS guard are bound to every execution.
allowed_incremental_allocation_classes: adapted recurrent hidden and cell state proved branch-dependent
selected midpoint-mutated parameters and optimizer coordinates proved branch-dependent
bounded adapter or full-update scratch with phase-scoped lifetime
SAFE-MIX integer posterior and transactional event state
rolling synchronization hashes and bounded first-divergence trace
forbidden_duplication_classes: PPMd or PAQ context stores not proved branch-dependent
fork_state_rule: Duplicate only state whose second-half adapted prediction differs from the authoritative parent. Feed both branches the same decoded truths. Parent persistent state and ordinary updates remain authoritative and continue at their native call sites.
copy_on_write_rule: Copy-on-write mappings receive no accounting discount. Every resident or dirty private page is charged to the process tree and cgroup peak; any write amplification must appear in the allocation manifest.
scratch_rule: Midpoint scratch must be allocated after the first-half state is complete, released by byte 64 unless explicitly retained by the frozen algorithm, and included in both RSS and temporary-disk accounting.
measurement_requirements: process-tree VmRSS sampled at no more than 0.5-second intervals
smaps_rollup at block activation, peak, rejoin, and terminal
allocation bytes by class before fork, at midpoint, during second half, after rejoin, and terminal
admission_pass_rule: The measured incremental peak is positive, completely attributed, no greater than the dynamic incremental limit, all forbidden duplication classes are absent, every guard passes, and P/K identity remains exact.
terminal_parent_above_target: Do not execute SAFE-FORK. Authorize only a memory-compilation successor or shift the primary prize lane to an open compact student.
terminal_incremental_over_budget: Do not promote SAFE-FORK. If the full midpoint and persistence evidence remain target-scale, authorize one compact branch-state successor; otherwise retire the family.
terminal_admission_pass: Authorize only the frozen tiny-scope SAFE-FORK P/K/D/M/R/S archive proof. Compression credit remains zero until an exact finite archive and inverse exist.
claim_boundary: Memory admission proves only that the declared fork can fit beside the qualified q1 parent under the bound host and guards. It proves no compression gain, causal attribution, transfer, package eligibility, or full-corpus result.
